label: Diagnóstico parcial de evidências; não é recomendação por perfil nem TCO completo.
weight_scope: Equal reference weights, identical for all six profiles; not fitted or elicited user preferences. This diagnostic tests evidence, not a new production recommender.

scenario.provenance: controlled scenario parameters; not observed vehicle data

formulas.criterion: 100*(x-min)/(max-min) for higher, 100*(max-x)/(max-min) for lower; only same-unit eligible observed evidence in the fixed cohort; constant dimension excluded, never assigned 50
formulas.effective_weight: positive original weight / sum of positive weights on available discriminating dimensions; decimal remainder assigned deterministically to the last available dimension
formulas.preview_score: sum of rounded criterion*effective_weight contributions; null when no discriminating evidence; coverage/confidence NOT added or multiplied
formulas.coverage: sum original weights with eligible evidence / sum all original weights; independent of score and explicitly not predictive confidence
formulas.monthly_tco_brl: fuel + maintenance/12 + observed IPVA/12 + observed insurance/12 + observed depreciation/12; null if ANY component unavailable
formulas.top10_jaccard: intersection/union of boundary-tie-expanded top10 sets; null when no comparable ranking
formulas.kendall_tau_b: (concordant-discordant)/sqrt((C+D+ties_left_only)*(C+D+ties_right_only)) over common scored vehicles; score ties retained, null if denominator zero

limitations: No 50/100 or universal segment level; unavailable stays null. No legacy demonstrative score is imported.
Reference weights and linear utilities are unvalidated preference assumptions, not technical facts. Human preference elicitation and rubrics are still required.
Cargo litres measure cargo capacity, not overall cabin space or comfort; no automatic conversion to a broad space score.
Different evidence subsets are not comparable final recommendations. Mixed FIPE reference months block a pooled preview.
Historical 2.5% maintenance, fixed 10% depreciation and legacy IPVA/insurance constants are excluded from observed evidence and from v2 TCO.
Legacy price cache is a local replay with live-status metadata, not a newly collected raw observation. Its explicit FIPE binding is preserved, not re-inferred by similarity.
All six profiles intentionally share the diagnostic scenario/weights. Missing profile-specific attributes cannot be replaced by selection groups, model names or desired outcomes.
No calibrated statistical confidence is available; provenance and weighted coverage are reported separately. Operational gates remain false.
